learning_outcomes.text: To introduce some selected inorganic processes to students.
To increase students' knowledge of using and preparing process flow charts.
To improve students' oral and written communication skills in Turkish.

syllabus_topics: National And International Legal Responsibilities Arising from the Universal and Social Health, Environment and Safety Effects of Chemical Processes
Boron and Some Other Inorganic Technologies
